query:
SELECT 
    tv.control_number,
    tv.sequence_number,
    tv.violator_id,
    tv.status_description,
    tv.gdate_happened,
    tv.gdate_paid,
    tv.original_fine,
    tv.actual_fine,
    tv.is_discounted,
    tv.violation_type_description,
    tv.registry_location,
    tv.vehicle_make,
    tv.vehicle_model,
    tv.district,
    tv.city,
    tv.region,
    d.person_type
FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation tv
LEFT JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON tv.violator_id = d.id
ORDER BY tv.gdate_happened DESC
LIMIT 2000
